title: Control-character advisory on every Edit/Write, sharing the gate's rule
changelog: **Control-character warning while editing (v59.70):** the post-edit hook now warns (never blocks) when an edited file carries a control character such as a U+0008 left by a shell heredoc, using the same rule as ci-control-char-check (scripts/lib/control-chars.mjs); the v59.69 reaction-read defect was found only by CI after the push.

qa.text: v59.70: scripts/agent-hook.mjs post-edit warns on a U+0008 in the edited file, stays silent on tab/CR/LF, and imports the rule ci-control-char-check uses
